data: Microsoft delivered a strong fiscal 2025, with revenue rising 14.9% to $281.7 billion from $245.1 billion in fiscal 2024. Profitability kept pace with the top line. Gross profit climbed to $193.9 billion in fiscal 2025 from $171.0 billion in fiscal 2024, which equates to a fiscal 2025 gross margin of 68.8%. Operating income advanced to $128.5 billion from $109.4 billion, yielding a fiscal 2025 operating margin of 45.6%. Net income grew 15.5% to $101.8 billion in fiscal 2025 from $88.1 billion in fiscal 2024, slightly outpacing revenue growth, and diluted EPS rose to $13.64 per share from $11.80. Notably, the company sustained heavy investment while expanding earnings, lifting R&D expense to $32.5 billion in fiscal 2025 from $29.5 billion in fiscal 2024. We view the combination of double-digit growth and high margins as a sign of durable operating leverage.
